title: Inverse section formula for ambient pushforward composition
statement: Fix the prime and finite coefficient field and a finite or whole-sequence ambient site. For the selected pushforward composition comparison, the inverse component on every module section is restriction along the forward canonical fibre-product composition comparison. This includes horizontal sequence arrows. The actual functors, selected isomorphism, site size and independent coefficient universe are those of [lem-sf-ambient-pullback-site-constructions].

source.place: Tags 03D3 and 0941; inverse cancellation of the specified fibre-product-pasting section formula.

proof.text: Evaluate the forward comparison formula on the inverse image of the section. The isomorphism inverse law identifies its left side with the section. Restrict by the forward fibre-product comparison. Functoriality of the module presheaf and the fibre-product inverse law cancel the composite with its inverse restriction. Reverse the resulting equality to obtain the inverse section formula.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03D3 and 0941; existing IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems inverse section calculation, generalized to either ambient site.

lean.statement:
theorem pushComp_inverse_sections {V W Z : Scheme.{t}}
    (h : Z ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ V) (s : Option ℕ) (M : Modules ell E Z s)
    (U : Site V s) (x : ((push ell E h s ⋙ push ell E k s).obj M).val.obj (op U)) :
    (((pushComp_existsUnique ell E h k s).exists.choose.inv.app M).val.app (op U)) x =
      M.val.map ((baseComp h k s).hom.app U).op x
